title: The Last Garden Again
author: Ulyana Brightwater
blurb: Mara Villalobos, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
